d:
Students and teachers ran for safety as fireworks exploded inside a school in Chelles, France, on November 9, 2026. Similar incidents were reported at other schools across the country. The scenes unfolded amid nationwide student protests over teacher shortages, deteriorating school buildings and worsening conditions in France’s education system.
